mapper.select: SELECT id FROM identity_session WHERE id = (SELECT session_id FROM identity_refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{hash}) AND client_type = 'PORTAL' FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.phone, a.status = 'ENABLED' AS enabled, a.credential_version AS account_version, s.credential_version AS session_version, a.permission_version, s.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AS revoked, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS current_utc, s.idle_expires_at, s.absolute_expires_at, t.expires_at, t.consumed_at FROM identity_session s JOIN identity_account a ON a.id = s.account_id JOIN identity_refresh_token t ON t.session_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND t.token_hash = #{hash} FOR SHARE OF a, t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_refresh_token (token_hash, session_id, issued_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{hash}, #{id}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE identity_refresh_token SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE token_hash = #{hash}
UPDATE identity_session SET last_used_at = #{lastUsedAt}, idle_expires_at = #{idleDeadline} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE identity_session SET revoked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND idle_expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND absolute_expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_portal_refresh_replay_audit (session_id, account_id, trace_id, occurred_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{accountId}, #{traceId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
